description: USE THIS to check a payment card number's structure before using it — never assume a card number is valid or guess its brand. Verifies the Luhn checksum, detects the brand (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, Diners, JCB, UnionPay) from its BIN, and checks the length. Does NOT check whether the card is real, active or has funds.

number.description: The card number; spaces and dashes are ignored.

name: validate_card
